name: Acacia Court Bungalow
structure: Loadbearing masonry and reinforced concrete ring beams
brief: Three bedrooms around a central living space, with a shaded entrance, separate service yard and a pitched clay-tile roof. The client brief prioritises a single-level plan and generous daylight.
update: The team handed over the bungalow and walked through the water shut-offs, electrical board and roof access points.
next: The client will use the sample handover checklist for the first defects review.
issue: A paint touch-up to the pantry jamb is covered by the defects log.
change: Extend the entrance porch
The porch work ran alongside external finishes.
render: Clay-tile roofs and locally sourced stone at the bungalow entrance

name: Kite Plains Health Centre
structure: Reinforced concrete frame with masonry infill and a light steel canopy
brief: One-storey outpatient clinic with a covered drop-off, separated patient and staff movement, two consulting bays, dispensary and shaded waiting veranda.
update: The clinic walkthrough closed the joinery and access items. The facilities team received the service register and keys.
next: Review the sample system operation checklist with the facilities representative.
issue: The sample facilities team recorded a follow-up check on the veranda rainwater outlet.
change: Screen the covered waiting veranda
The screen installation shared the canopy work sequence.
render: Shaded veranda and green drop-off canopy at the health centre

name: Red Earth Learning Centre
structure: Masonry classroom wings, reinforced concrete ties and steel roof trusses
brief: An L-shaped teaching block enclosing a shaded courtyard. The scope includes four classrooms, a resource room, accessible washrooms and rainwater storage.
update: Classrooms, external circulation and rainwater storage were inspected. The board accepted the sample room inventory at handover.
next: Complete the seasonal inspection of the harvested-water system.
issue: The recess finish at the resource room window is logged for defects review.
change: Extend covered access to the resource room
The steel canopy was fabricated off site during classroom finishes.
render: Red brick classroom wings and a shaded school courtyard

name: Westbridge Office House
structure: Reinforced concrete frame with a central stair and lift core
brief: Four-storey neighbourhood office with a central circulation core, split tenancy floors, protected pedestrian entry and horizontal shade fins.
update: The sample tenant handover pack was issued with keys, equipment schedules and facade access notes.
next: Record the first defects review with the building manager.
issue: A facade sealant touch-up remains in the sample defects register.
change: Add independent electrical metering to two suites
The revised meter commissioning moved the sample handover milestone five days.
render: A four-storey office facade with glazed bays and horizontal sunshades

name: Basalt Lane Apartments
structure: Reinforced concrete frame, block infill and precast balcony edges
brief: Five-storey walk-up apartment building, with recessed balconies, two repeat apartment types, shared services and a volcanic-stone entrance wall.
update: The team completed the remaining sample apartment snag checks. Common-area drawings and metering schedules went to the cooperative.
next: Track the balustrade and plumbing follow-up at the first occupancy review.
issue: The cooperative confirmed a sample spare-key register for the common rooms.
change: Upgrade balcony privacy screens
The revised screen installation was phased by stack during fit-out.
render: Recessed apartment balconies and a central volcanic-stone facade band

name: Reedbank Lodge
structure: Volcanic-stone walls, reinforced concrete ties and exposed timber roof trusses
brief: A timber-and-stone lodge reception and dining pavilion with a sheltered arrival, lounge, covered terrace and separate service access.
update: The team completed the sample finishes inspection and the lodge representative received the maintenance schedule.
next: Inspect the exposed timber finish after the first rainy period.
issue: The sample dashboard records a client query about terrace drainage maintenance.
change: Extend the sheltered dining terrace
Terrace work ran while the pavilion kitchen was fitted.
render: Timber gable and volcanic stone on a lakeside lodge pavilion

name: Stonecrest Community Church
structure: Reinforced concrete perimeter frame and long-span steel roof trusses
brief: A contemporary sanctuary with a clear-span main hall, tall gabled entrance, vestry, small meeting room, accessible circulation and acoustic lining.
update: The team fitted the reviewed acoustic panels and finished the main entrance glazing. Lighting circuits went through the first functional check.
next: Complete the sample sound and lighting tests before the client walk-through.
issue: The revised wayfinding layout is awaiting the client’s decision.
change: Add timber acoustic backing to the sanctuary wall
The backing must be fitted before final acoustic tests.
render: Stone wings and a glazed gabled entrance at the church

name: Savanna Freight Depot
structure: Steel portal frames over concrete pads, with a reinforced industrial floor
brief: A regional logistics warehouse with three loading positions, a separated office entrance, heavy-duty slab and outdoor truck staging.
update: The main steel frame is complete. The team fitted the first facade sheets and prepared the loading apron bays.
next: Complete the roof closure and sequence the sample dock leveller installation.
issue: The client is reviewing a revised dock shelter request.
change: Widen the east loading canopy
The extra canopy can share the main cladding mobilisation.
render: Steel portal-frame warehouse with three sheltered loading docks

name: Juniper Junction Mixed Use
structure: Reinforced concrete frame, core walls and one basement parking level
brief: Street-level retail with five mixed-use floors and one basement. The team is coordinating deep facade shading, the service risers and separate tenant circulation.
update: The crew placed the fourth floor slab and checked service openings against the issued coordination plan.
next: Release the next formwork cycle after the service riser review.
issue: The sample cost plan flags additional steel and temporary works. The client is reviewing the retail entry package.
change: Relocate the retail service riser
Riser rerouting precedes the affected floor’s services installation.
render: Retail frontage beneath six levels of terracotta and white facade bands

name: Highland Student Court
structure: Reinforced concrete frames and masonry walls to two courtyard wings
brief: Two student accommodation wings face a common courtyard. The sample programme includes shared study, laundry, accessible bedrooms and shaded walkways.
update: The crew finished reduced-level excavation in the east wing and checked the courtyard drainage sleeves before the next pour.
next: Start the west wing foundation sequence after the sample setting-out review.
issue: The revised courtyard footpath drainage detail is with the client and design team.
change: Allow for a covered study courtyard connection
The connection uses a later site works package.
render: Two student residence wings enclosing a landscaped shared courtyard
